name: Forest Cabin
description: A log cabin in a pine forest whose sky and light follow the time of day: night, dawn, day, golden hour, sunset and dusk, with smoke curling from the chimney.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; ['Hour','Colon','Minute'].forEach((nm,i)=>{ project.elements[n-3+i].name = nm + ' Aod'; }); return 1
